description: Stable process exit codes and JSON result envelope for the Specromancy POC.

exit_codes.meaning: Safety or policy check rejected the operation
exit_codes.name: SAFETY_REJECTED

exit_codes.meaning: Run lock or concurrent modification conflict
exit_codes.name: CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT

command.description: Canonical command name without user-provided arguments.

data.description: Command-specific structured result. Empty object on errors when there is no safe partial result.

errors.description: Zero or more structured errors. Empty on success.

details.description: Safe scalar context only; no secrets, prompts, credentials, or environment dumps.

path.description: Repository-relative normalized path associated with the error, or null.

retryable.description: Whether retrying without changing arguments may succeed.

message.description: Concise top-level outcome safe for logs.

ok.description: True exactly when process exit code is zero.

rules: The process exit code is the highest-priority primary failure, not a sum or bitmask.
Expected user errors do not emit tracebacks unless an explicit debug mode is active.
Text and JSON modes use the same process exit code.
JSON mode writes exactly one envelope to stdout; diagnostics that would corrupt it must not be written to stdout.
Messages, hints, paths, and details must be redacted before persistence or output.
